notes.title: Chapter 3 for alpha testing releasing next week!
notes.notes:
Next week on the 10th of April, exactly one year since I began my adventure with pixel art which led to creating this game, I will be releasing chapter 3 for alpha testing!

In chapter 3 apposed to the previous chapters you will be able to fully play as Grover and switch between the two characters. The puzzle will require completing tasks with both characters and helping each other where needed.

This feature required some major changes to all the game systems, but it was all carefully tested and hopefully bug free.

The alpha version will be missing some additional in-game animations, nothing important to game-play or story, mostly eye candy stuff.

The alpha will include some new music demos and sound design, but not all that is planned.

All cut-scenes will be included in full, but they will go through some extra polishing for the final version.

All dialogues are included, but may also go through extra polishing.

Other than that, everything else is in there!

If you want to help and test the alpha version, send us an email to mail@headbangames.com or DM us on any of our socials.

Stay tuned for more updates and as ever you're welcome to visit the [url=https://headbangames.com/ua/devblog/]Dev Blog[/url] for more in depth updates.

notes.title: Chapter 2 is almost ready for alpha testing!
notes.notes:
Next week we'll be launching the alpha version of episode 2 for testing.

The alpha version will be missing some additional in-game animations, nothing important to gameplay or story, mostly eye candy stuff.

The alpha will include some new music demos and sound design, but not all that is planned.

All cutscenes will be included in full, but they will go through some extra polishing for the final version.

All dialogues are included, but may also go through extra polishing.

Other than that, everything else is in there, locations, characters, gameplay & puzzles, etc.

If you want to help and test the alpha version, send us an email to mail@headbangames.com or DM us on any of our socials.

We're hoping to get the build into a beta version by February and then start working on episode 3.

Stay tuned for more updates and as ever you're welcome to visit the [url=headbangames.com/ua/devblog/]Dev Blog[/url] for more in depth updates.
